name: Legal-Metrology-NER
note: Canonical ML-side entity label config. MUST mirror nlp-service/app/entities.py (enforced by nlp-service/tests/test_entities.py).

labels.label: PRODUCT_NAME
labels.description: Common or generic name of the commodity as declared on the label.

labels.label: MANUFACTURER
labels.description: Name of the manufacturing company (not the address).

labels.label: PACKER
labels.description: Name of the packer when different from the manufacturer.
examples: Packed by: Fresh Foods Pvt Ltd

labels.label: IMPORTER
labels.description: Name of the importer for imported goods.

labels.label: NET_QUANTITY
labels.description: Declared net quantity / weight / volume (value with or without unit).

labels.label: MRP
labels.description: Retail sale price declaration including its currency marker.

labels.label: MFG_DATE
labels.description: Month & year of manufacture, in any surface form.

labels.label: CUSTOMER_CARE
labels.description: Consumer-care contact: phone, email or URL labelled for complaints.

labels.label: ADDRESS
labels.description: Postal address block of the manufacturer / packer / importer.

labels.label: INGREDIENTS
labels.description: Ingredients list heading plus the list itself.
examples: Ingredients: Wheat flour, sugar, edible oil
